visualCharacteristics.structure: two columns: vertical list of numbered industry tabs (left) switching a panel (right) with a cover image and overlaid H3, paragraph and link
visualCharacteristics.summary: Vertical list of 9 numbered industry selectors on the left switching a right-hand panel with image, H3, paragraph and link (one panel per industry)

contentPattern.structure: one row per industry: tab label (numbering /01, /02 is added automatically) | image, H3, paragraph, link. If the label cell is omitted, the panel heading is used as the tab label
